parameters.name: Api-Version
parameters.description:
The endpoint's API Version. 

Must be provided through the headers section.

schema.description: The endpoint's API Version.  Must be provided through headers.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description:
Correlates a series of requests within the same flow.

Note: This ID is generated by Moneris with every request or response, if it doesn't exist. 
Merchants are to echo back the value with every request that is part of the call flow."

parameters.name: X-Merchant-Id
parameters.description:
Thirteen character identification code. 

Note: This code is provided by Moneris and is required to identify the Merchant executing the transaction."

schema.description: Thirteen character long identification provided to merchants by Moneris.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payments.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor to return items located after it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return in the response.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Returns items created after the specified date, defaults to the current date starting from 12 AM.

schema.description: Date & Time

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description:
Returns items created before the specified date, up to one day earlier. 

Defaults to current date and time, must be no more than 1 day later than `created_from` date.

paymentMethodInformation.title: Card Payment Method Information
paymentMethodInformation.description: Details about the card used in the payment method.

paymentMethodType.description:
The type of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - Card.

paymentMethodSource.description:
The source of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - The Id of a Payment Method already created.
  - Permanent Token.
  - Temporary Token.
  - Card.
  - E-Wallet.

cardInformation.description: Information about the card being used for the transaction

bankIdentificationNumber.description:
**BIN**: Bank Identification Number 

Consists of the first six to eight digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN) and identifies the relevant payment network and the specific payment issuing institution.

expiryMonth.description: Card expiration month. Format must be MM

expiryYear.description: Displays the card expiration year. Accepted format: YYYY

cardBrand.description: Displays the card brand name associated with the card type.

cardType.description: Specifies the intended card use; i.e. debit or credit.

cardFingerprint.description:
Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

responseCode.description:
"Details Transaction Response Codes:
- **< 50**: Transaction approved
- **> 50**: Transaction declined
NULL: Transaction not sent for authorization
For a complete list of definitions, refer to the Response Codes Table"

authorizationCode.description:
Contains a value generated by the authorizer for an approved financial transactions. 
This operates as the authorizing host's transaction identification.

message.description:
Displays response description returned from issuing institution.

**NOTE**: This message should not be displayed on any cardholder facing materials.  

For receipt purposes, please refer to the Receipt Requirements"

ecommerceIndicator.description:
The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

cardSecurityCodeResultCode.description:
Indicates the Card Security Code validation result.
- **MATCH**
- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

schema.description: Error response details.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

**Note**: The combined length of the merchant's business name, forward slash '/' character, and the dynamic descriptor may not exceed 22 characters.

Optionally an unit number can be provided.

paymentMethodInformation.title: Card Payment Method Information
paymentMethodInformation.description: Details about the card used in the payment method.

paymentMethodType.description:
The type of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - Card.

paymentMethodSource.description:
The source of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - The Id of a Payment Method already created.
  - Permanent Token.
  - Temporary Token.
  - Card.
  - E-Wallet.

cardInformation.description: Information about the card being used for the transaction

bankIdentificationNumber.description:
**BIN**: Bank Identification Number 

Consists of the first six to eight digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN) and identifies the relevant payment network and the specific payment issuing institution.

expiryMonth.description: Card expiration month. Format must be MM

expiryYear.description: Displays the card expiration year. Accepted format: YYYY

cardBrand.description: Displays the card brand name associated with the card type.

cardType.description: Specifies the intended card use; i.e. debit or credit.

cardFingerprint.description:
Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

isoResponseCode.description: Represents the Moneris response code for the equivalent International Organization for Standardization (ISO) response code.

responseCode.description:
"Details Transaction Response Codes:
- **< 50**: Transaction approved
- **> 50**: Transaction declined
NULL: Transaction not sent for authorization
For a complete list of definitions, refer to the Response Codes Table"

authorizationCode.description:
Contains a value generated by the authorizer for an approved financial transactions. 
This operates as the authorizing host's transaction identification.

message.description:
Displays response description returned from issuing institution.

**NOTE**: This message should not be displayed on any cardholder facing materials.  

For receipt purposes, please refer to the Receipt Requirements"

ecommerceIndicator.description:
The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

cardSecurityCodeResultCode.description:
Indicates the Card Security Code validation result.
- **MATCH**
- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

schema.description: Error response details.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

Indicates the merchant-defined transaction identifer or order ID. Identifiers are unique for every Purchase, Pre-Authorization and Independent Refund transaction

**Note**: No two transactions of these types may have the same order ID. Field only accepts alphanumerical characters, dashes and underscores.

rate.description: The Convenience Fee rate that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

feeType.description: The type of Convenience Fee that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

cardholderInformation.description: Information about the holder of the card.

email.description:

billingAddress.description:
The postal address including street, town/city, province, and postal code.
Optionally an unit number can be provided.

country.description:
Provides the two letter country code according the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. 
For a complete list of country codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

paymentMethodInformation.title: Card Payment Method Information
paymentMethodInformation.description: Details about the card used in the payment method.

paymentMethodType.description:
The type of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - Card.

paymentMethodSource.description:
The source of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - The Id of a Payment Method already created.
  - Permanent Token.
  - Temporary Token.
  - Card.
  - E-Wallet.

cardInformation.description: Information about the card being used for the transaction

bankIdentificationNumber.description:
**BIN**: Bank Identification Number 

Consists of the first six to eight digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN) and identifies the relevant payment network and the specific payment issuing institution.

expiryMonth.description: Card expiration month. Format must be MM

expiryYear.description: Displays the card expiration year. Accepted format: YYYY

cardBrand.description: Displays the card brand name associated with the card type.

cardType.description: Specifies the intended card use; i.e. debit or credit.

cardFingerprint.description:
Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

modifiedAt.description: Time at which the object was modified

customData.description: Merchant can send custom meta data with the transaction in this object. Moneris will echo these values back in response.

transactionDetails.description: Additional details about the transaction outcome.

transactionUniqueId.description: Realtime transaction identifier from the host.

isoResponseCode.description: Represents the Moneris response code for the equivalent International Organization for Standardization (ISO) response code.

responseCode.description:
"Details Transaction Response Codes:
- **< 50**: Transaction approved
- **> 50**: Transaction declined
NULL: Transaction not sent for authorization
For a complete list of definitions, refer to the Response Codes Table"

authorizationCode.description:
Contains a value generated by the authorizer for an approved financial transactions. 
This operates as the authorizing host's transaction identification.

message.description:
Displays response description returned from issuing institution.

**NOTE**: This message should not be displayed on any cardholder facing materials.  

For receipt purposes, please refer to the Receipt Requirements"

ecommerceIndicator.description:
The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

cardSecurityCodeResultCode.description:
Indicates the Card Security Code validation result.
- **MATCH**
- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

schema.description: Error response details.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

status.description: Indicates the status of the merchant and convenience fee transactions.

currency.description:

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

rate.description: The Convenience Fee rate that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

feeType.description: The type of Convenience Fee that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

customerReference.description: Unique Identification for the Customer. This can be an identifier generated from a merchant-defined identifier.

paymentMethodId.description: Unique Identifier of the payment method.

merchantId.description: Thirteen character long identification provided to merchants by Moneris.

cardholderInformation.description: Information about the holder of the card.

email.description:
Contains the customer's email address.

For standard email protocols, visit: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5322

billingAddress.description:
The postal address including street, town/city, province, and postal code.
Optionally an unit number can be provided.

country.description:
Provides the two letter country code according the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. 
For a complete list of country codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

paymentMethodInformation.title: Card Payment Method Information
paymentMethodInformation.description: Details about the card used in the payment method.

paymentMethodType.description:
The type of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - Card.

paymentMethodSource.description:
The source of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - The Id of a Payment Method already created.
  - Permanent Token.
  - Temporary Token.
  - Card.
  - E-Wallet.

cardInformation.description: Information about the card being used for the transaction

bankIdentificationNumber.description:
**BIN**: Bank Identification Number 

Consists of the first six to eight digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN) and identifies the relevant payment network and the specific payment issuing institution.

expiryMonth.description: Card expiration month. Format must be MM

expiryYear.description: Displays the card expiration year. Accepted format: YYYY

cardBrand.description: Displays the card brand name associated with the card type.

cardType.description: Specifies the intended card use; i.e. debit or credit.

cardFingerprint.description:
Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

createdAt.description: Time at which the object was created

modifiedAt.description: Time at which the object was modified

customData.description: Merchant can send custom meta data with the transaction in this object. Moneris will echo these values back in response.

transactionDetails.description: Additional details about the transaction outcome.

transactionUniqueId.description: Realtime transaction identifier from the host.

isoResponseCode.description: Represents the Moneris response code for the equivalent International Organization for Standardization (ISO) response code.

responseCode.description:
"Details Transaction Response Codes:
- **< 50**: Transaction approved
- **> 50**: Transaction declined
NULL: Transaction not sent for authorization
For a complete list of definitions, refer to the Response Codes Table"

authorizationCode.description:
Contains a value generated by the authorizer for an approved financial transactions. 
This operates as the authorizing host's transaction identification.

message.description:
Displays response description returned from issuing institution.

**NOTE**: This message should not be displayed on any cardholder facing materials.  

For receipt purposes, please refer to the Receipt Requirements"

ecommerceIndicator.description:
The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

cardSecurityCodeResultCode.description:
Indicates the Card Security Code validation result.
- **MATCH**
- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

storePaymentMethod.description:

- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data. The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

ApiKeyAuth.description:
An API key is a token that a client provides when making API calls.

API keys are supposed to be a secret that only the client and server know about.

OAuth2.description:
OAuth 2.0 is an authorization protocol that gives an API client limited access to user data on a web server.

OAuth relies on authentication scenarios, that allows the resource owner (user) to share the protected content from the server, hosting the resource, without sharing their credentials. For that purpose, an OAuth 2.0 server issues access tokens that the client applications can use to access protected resources on behalf of the resource owner.

Moneris recommends the use of OAuth 2.0 as it provides fine grained authorization levels.

parameterName.description: Property or header name. Can contain nested path separated by '.'

parameterValue.description: Property or header value string representation.

errorMessage.description: Human readable description of the error.
errorMessage.example: String 'MAP3J8' does not match the postal code pattern.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."

schema.description: Returns a processed payment

merchantId.description: Thirteen character long identification provided to merchants by Moneris.

orderId.description:
Indicates the merchant-defined transaction identifer or order ID. Identifiers are unique for every Purchase, Pre-Authorization and Independent Refund transaction

**Note**: No two transactions of these types may have the same order ID. Field only accepts alphanumerical characters, dashes and underscores.

invoiceNumber.description: Submits a unique value to identify a transaction that is logged by Moneris Solutions.

transactionDateTime.description: Indicates the date and time of the transaction.

createdAt.description: Time at which the object was created

modifiedAt.description: Time at which the object was modified

amount.description: This amount excludes surcharge, application and convenience fee.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

authorizedAmount.description: This represents the funds that are held by the authorization on the payment method.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

capturableAmount.description: Remaining amount that can still be captured.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

amountDetails.description: Contains information pertaining to the subtotal, tip, and surcharge amounts of a Payment

subTotalAmount.description:
Sub total amount for the transaction. 
Note: The value must be in cents. Therefore $10.59 must be sent as 1059.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

tipAmount.description:
Total tip amount for the transaction. 
Note: The value must be in cents. Therefore $10.59 must be sent as 1059

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

surchargeAmount.description:
Monetary amount. 
Note: The value must be in cents. Therefore $10.59 must be sent as 1059.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

convenienceFeeDetails.description: Contains information about a Convenience Fee transaction.

status.description: Indicates the status of the merchant and convenience fee transactions.

currency.description:
Provides the three letter currency code according the ISO 4217 standard. 

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

rate.description: The Convenience Fee rate that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

feeType.description: The type of Convenience Fee that has been defined on the merchant’s profile.

customerReference.description: Unique Identification for the Customer. This can be an identifier generated from a merchant-defined identifier.

paymentMethodId.description: Unique Identifier of the payment method.

merchantId.description: Thirteen character long identification provided to merchants by Moneris.

cardholderInformation.description: Information about the holder of the card.

email.description:
Contains the customer's email address.

For standard email protocols, visit: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5322

billingAddress.description:
The postal address including street, town/city, province, and postal code.
Optionally an unit number can be provided.

country.description:
Provides the two letter country code according the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. 
For a complete list of country codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

paymentMethodInformation.title: Card Payment Method Information
paymentMethodInformation.description: Details about the card used in the payment method.

paymentMethodType.description:
The type of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - Card.

paymentMethodSource.description:
The source of Payment Method being used. It can be:
  - The Id of a Payment Method already created.
  - Permanent Token.
  - Temporary Token.
  - Card.
  - E-Wallet.

cardInformation.description: Information about the card being used for the transaction

bankIdentificationNumber.description:
**BIN**: Bank Identification Number 

Consists of the first six to eight digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN) and identifies the relevant payment network and the specific payment issuing institution.

expiryMonth.description: Card expiration month. Format must be MM

expiryYear.description: Displays the card expiration year. Accepted format: YYYY

cardBrand.description: Displays the card brand name associated with the card type.

cardType.description: Specifies the intended card use; i.e. debit or credit.

cardFingerprint.description:
Unique card identifier. 

Fingerprinting randomly assigns identfiers for cards that share the same Primary Account Number (PAN) to easily identify when multiple payments methods are attached to the same underlying card, and assists merchants identify individual customers across various channels; i.e.  loyalty programs.

paymentAccountReference.description: Used to link Primary Account Number (PAN) based transactions and transactions on associated payment tokens without using the PAN as the linking mechanism.

storePaymentMethod.description:
Store this payment method created through this payment for future use. 
- DO_NOT_STORE: Payment method will not be stored.
- CARDHOLDER_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can only re-used with cardholder's consent. Limited to store, pre-authorisation, and card validations."
- MERCHANT_INITIATED: Payment method to be stored and can be reused without the cardholder's consent. For example, subscriptions.

createdAt.description: Time at which the object was created

modifiedAt.description: Time at which the object was modified

customData.description: Merchant can send custom meta data with the transaction in this object. Moneris will echo these values back in response.

transactionDetails.description: Additional details about the transaction outcome.

transactionUniqueId.description: Realtime transaction identifier from the host.

isoResponseCode.description: Represents the Moneris response code for the equivalent International Organization for Standardization (ISO) response code.

responseCode.description:
"Details Transaction Response Codes:
- **< 50**: Transaction approved
- **> 50**: Transaction declined
NULL: Transaction not sent for authorization
For a complete list of definitions, refer to the Response Codes Table"

authorizationCode.description:
Contains a value generated by the authorizer for an approved financial transactions. 
This operates as the authorizing host's transaction identification.

message.description:
Displays response description returned from issuing institution.

**NOTE**: This message should not be displayed on any cardholder facing materials.  

For receipt purposes, please refer to the Receipt Requirements"

ecommerceIndicator.description:
The ecommerce indicator (ECI) specifies the level of security that was used to obtain the cardholder's payment data. 
It is sent by the merchant and returned by the issuer.
When returned in the response, it can be different from the value sent in the request in case transaction was downgraded by the issuer.

cardSecurityCodeResultCode.description:
Indicates the Card Security Code validation result.
- **MATCH**
- **NO_MATCH**
- **NOT_PROCESSED**
- **CVD_NOT_PRESENT**
- **NOT_CVD_PRESENT**
- **AMEX_JCB_MATCH**
- **AMEX_JCB_INVALID**
- **OTHER**"

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

credentialOnFileResponse.description: Contains fields related to the Credential on File (CoF)

originalAmount.description:
Original amount for the first transaction in the series. 
Note: The value must be in cents. Therefore $10.59 must be sent as 1059

currency.description:

For a complete list of currency codes, visit: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217

issuerId.description:
Displays a unique identifier for the card holder's stored credentials. 

This information is returned from the card brand when processing a Credential on File transaction.

multiCurrencyPricingDetails.description: Exchange rate for use in a subsequent MCP financial transaction

cardholderAmount.description:

merchantSettlementAmount.description: The amount that will be paid to the merchant, in settlement currency

currency.description:

multiCurrencyPricingExchangeRate.description: The foreign exchange rate (foreign currency to CAD) that will be used for the transaction

refundDetails.description: Refund details if any has occured.

refunds.description: List of Refunds associated with this Payment

items.description: Refund reference.

subscription.description: Subscription reference, if this transaction is related to a subscription.

planId.description: Visa-generated identifier for an Installment plan.

planIdReference.description: A Visa-generated, alphanumeric, unique, and short human-readable friendly name for Installment Plan.

planTermsAndConditionsVersion.description: Installment Plan Terms and Conditions Version. Version of the Terms & Conditions accepted by the consumer. The version is auto-incremented every time an update is made to the Plan by the issuer.

planAcceptanceId.description: Visa-generated identifier for a plan acceptance.

threeDSecureAuthenticationValueResultCod.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV), the Account holder Authentication Value (AAV), and the American Express Verification Value (AEVV),  are the values that allows Visa, Mastercard and American Express to validate the integrity of the Visa Secure,  Mastercard Identity Check and American Express SafeKey transaction data.  These values are passed back from the issuer to the merchant after the authentication has taken place.  The merchant then integrates the CAVV/AAV/AEVV value into the authorization request using the Payment request with 3-D Secure transaction data.

schema.description: Error response details.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.
